---
title: "VO2 Max Comparison Report"
output: html_document
params:
  input_vals: NULL
  comparison_plot: NULL
  selected_plots: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}

tibble::tibble(
  Sex = params$input_vals$gender,
  Age = params$input_vals$age,
  Height_cm = params$input_vals$height,
  Weight_kg = params$input_vals$weight,
  Mode = params$input_vals$mode,
  Measured_VO2 = params$input_vals$measuredVO2
) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Input Parameters")
```



```{r}
params$comparison_plot
```

```{r}
for (plot_name in names(params$selected_plots)) {
  cat(paste0("### ", plot_name, " VO2 Plot\n\n"))
  print(params$selected_plots[[plot_name]])
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
